ranked.headline: Deep learning tools advance pathology and cell phenotyping from tissue images
ranked.summary: Recent work pairs released tooling and standardized benchmarking with image-based and spatial omics analysis across several modalities.

ranked.headline: Software standardizes platform-specific omics outputs for downstream analysis
ranked.summary: Recent preprints address format conversion, validation, and scalable processing of metabolomics and crosslinking MS outputs from multiple platforms and engines.

ranked.headline: Optimal dosing and density-dependent defenses shape infection and epidemic control
ranked.summary: Preprints now model time-dependent interventions against infection and transmission endpoints, from biofilm dosing to epidemic extinction.

ranked.headline: Learned models prioritize small molecules and peptides against diverse biological targets
ranked.summary: Recent items pair learned models with screening to prioritize kinase inhibitors, antimicrobial peptides, and cancer cell responses to cytotoxic compounds.

ranked.headline: Simulation and NMR data refine conformational ensembles of flexible biomolecules
ranked.summary: Force field benchmarks, NMR-restrained coarse-grained models, and MD studies of aggregation now test energy functions against experimental conformational data.

ranked.headline: Computational models of cancer omics infer metabolism, telomere biology, and drug response
ranked.summary: Pan-cancer proteogenomic and telomere resources now pair multi-omics data with drug sensitivity and dependency screens.

ranked.headline: Federated mixed models, LD score regression, and ancestry inference refine trait genetics
ranked.summary: Federated and haplotype-based methods now address privacy, ancestry resolution, and reference-panel gaps in association analysis.

ranked.headline: Graph and transformer encoders learn protein and molecular structure for prediction
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and papers pair graph architectures with physics, dynamics, and substructure information for binding and property prediction.

ranked.headline: MD simulations link binding and partitioning outcomes to specific residues and charges
ranked.summary: Recent MD and polymer models resolve which molecular features govern binding and partitioning across nucleosome and condensate systems.

ranked.headline: Reference genomes and truth sets sharpen variant calling and alignment accuracy
ranked.summary: Defined truth sets and references now allow measurable accuracy assessment of variant calling, alignment, and copy number inference.

ranked.headline: Individual-specific whole-brain models from fMRI co-activity and parcellation comparison
ranked.summary: Recent work pairs individual connectivity inference from fMRI with multivariate comparison of subject-specific network configurations.

ranked.headline: Quantitative classification and atlases place biological structure on shared spatial axes
ranked.summary: Recent Drosophila atlases and nanoscale network classification enable quantitative mapping of tissue and membrane organization.

ranked.headline: Learned representations couple spatial omics to tissue domains, cell states and alignment
ranked.summary: Spatial omics methods now span domain detection, multimodal alignment and histology-linked prognosis, extending representation learning across tissue scales.

ranked.headline: Genome-scale microbial surveys map exopolysaccharide and selenoprotein gene content
ranked.summary: Expanded metagenomic and genome collections now enable predictive mining of specific functional gene families across diverse environments.

ranked.headline: Isoform and single-cell resolution map neuronal states and cell-type enhancers
ranked.summary: Long-read, single-cell and generative models now resolve neuronal isoforms, cryptic exons and cell-type regulatory elements.

ranked.headline: Graph-structured deep learning predicts perturbation, interaction, and drug response
ranked.summary: Knowledge graphs, interaction networks, and single-cell transfer learning are now being combined to predict perturbation and drug-response phenotypes.

ranked.headline: Affinity models face distribution shift, confounds, and uncertainty-aware evaluation
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and a 2025 publication test whether binding-affinity models remain reliable under out-of-distribution shifts and dataset artifacts.

ranked.headline: Biology-specific language models for DNA, protein families and mRNA design
ranked.summary: Recent preprints extend generative language models to DNA, protein families and mRNA, benchmarking tokenization and fitness prediction.

ranked.headline: Adapting protein language models and structure samplers to stability and conformations
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and publications couple pretrained protein models with physical constraints or thermostability data to predict stability and conformations.

ranked.headline: LLMs guiding molecule edits, protein benchmarks, and PubMed-grounded synthesis
ranked.summary: Recent preprints tie LLM outputs to checkable external references: synthesizability criteria, validated protein data, and retrieved literature.

ranked.headline: Chromosome-scale assemblies link genome structure to resistance and oil composition
ranked.summary: Haplotype-resolved and pangenome assemblies now resolve gene copy content in polyploid and non-model taxa.

ranked.headline: Learned models for antibody affinity, immunogenicity, and neoepitope prediction
ranked.summary: Generative and ML tools now target antibody affinity, low immunogenicity, and neoepitope immunogenicity in recent preprints and publications.

ranked.headline: Defense and anti-defense turnover co-evolve across Enterobacteriaceae genomes
ranked.summary: Population-scale genome collections now allow direct tests of how accessory and mobile elements turn over under selection and surveillance pressure.

ranked.headline: Haplotype-resolved assemblies build reference-independent sequence layers across species
ranked.summary: Long-read and low-coverage sequencing data now support haplotype-resolved and mitogenome assemblies beyond single-reference frameworks.

ranked.headline: Benchmarking and ensembling ML predictors for protein function and pathogen effectors
ranked.summary: Recent benchmarks and integration studies emphasize evaluation design over single-model accuracy in biological prediction.

ranked.headline: Single-molecule sequencing resolves integration sites, subclonality and ctDNA mutations
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and publications report tools for lentiviral integration, single-cell DNA subclonality and ctDNA variant calling at molecular resolution.

ranked.headline: Mechanistic state models parameterize promoter, metabolic, and stress-response dynamics
ranked.summary: Calibrated mechanistic frameworks now tie cellular dynamics to experimental dwell times, thermodynamic limits, and stress-response calibration.

ranked.headline: Joint modeling of multi-omics networks, topics and chromatin tracks across modalities
ranked.summary: Recent preprints pair batch-corrected multi-omics integration with causal network inference and multimodal topic modelling across single-cell and spatial data.

ranked.headline: Ensemble and free-energy methods benchmarked for PROTAC, peptide, and Mpro binding
ranked.summary: Recent benchmarks test whether ensemble sampling and deep learning pose methods capture binding beyond single static poses.

ranked.headline: Open-source tools package neuroscience analyses for web, Python, and cloud access
ranked.summary: Recent releases lower access barriers to neuron modeling, atlas mapping, behavioral video analysis, and cloud-based morphology computation.

ranked.headline: Computational assignment of T-cell antigen specificity and tumor peptide presentation
ranked.summary: Single-cell pMHC multimer readouts and immunopeptidomics data now support statistical antigen assignment and tumor antigen prioritization.

ranked.headline: Polarizable and MD methods assessing ligand and nanoparticle binding to nucleic acids
ranked.summary: Recent work pairs explicit electronic polarization and 150+ μs simulations with AlphaFold 3 benchmarking to assess nucleic acid binding and structure.

ranked.headline: Deep learning models score regulatory and pathogenic effects of genomic variants
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and a publication apply deep learning to variant effect scoring across regulatory, mitochondrial, interaction, and RNA contexts.

ranked.headline: Residue-level structural descriptors assess AlphaFold models and local environments
ranked.summary: Proteome-scale AlphaFold-DB models and PDB non-canonical residues are now being assessed with structure-derived descriptors rather than pLDDT alone.

ranked.headline: GPU and k-mer algorithms speed up sequence alignment and genomic search
ranked.summary: Read alignment against millions of genomes and long-read datasets motivates memory-efficient, throughput-oriented redesigns of alignment and search kernels.

ranked.headline: Evaluations expose batch effects and sampling biases in single-cell method benchmarks
ranked.summary: Recent preprints show foundation-model embeddings retain batch effects and GRN benchmark negatives carry degree-based sampling bias.

ranked.headline: Chemical probing and nanopore sequencing sharpen RNA structure and modification calls
ranked.summary: Recent preprints apply physics-based ensemble modeling and AI-driven, parameter-optimized nanopore workflows to improve RNA analysis precision.

ranked.headline: Spatial single-cell profiling maps bladder niches and carotid plaque heterogeneity
ranked.summary: Spatial and single-cell readouts now pair tissue context with isoform-level and trajectory-level resolution across human and mouse samples.

ranked.headline: Mechanical models link cell deformation, nuclear passage, and forces to measured data
ranked.summary: Geometric PDE, Bayesian force inference, and fluid-structure simulation now couple cell mechanics to experimental and time-resolved data.
